title: Existing postinstall hook hardlinks a sibling file and writes it from a class field initialiser
intent: A hardlink from a sibling package's file into the package, written from a class field initialiser so the write's order relative to the link is not obvious from the text. Pins the shape that slipped past an attempt to prove install-time writes stay in the package; it stays high because the source names node_modules and writes. Inert fixture.
